en.headline: 3 commits, 4 issue actions, 1 discussion reply across openchamber and personal
en.summary: On 2026-10-15, `sogeisetsu` recorded **3 own commits** across two repositories, plus 10 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, the two own commits updated the daily-report pipeline so commit attribution recognizes aliases and non-GitHub account emails, and added a docs note on alias handling in the agents section. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, a single chore commit tagged the release as `v1.15.5`. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded. Issue activity totaled 4 actions in `openchamber/openchamber`: opened issue #4920 about the Context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message's input so `其他` stays at 0%, closed issue #4346 about `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passing after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`, and commented on both #4346 and #4111 (the latter about deleting a multi-run leaving orphaned MCP child processes and `git worktree remove --force` failing with Permission denied). The user also joined an existing discussion, #4821 in `openchamber/openchamber` titled "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel", which currently has 1 comment. No truncation flags were hit, so all listed activity is complete.

zh.headline: 3 次提交、4 次 issue 操作、1 条讨论回复，覆盖 openchamber 与个人仓库
zh.summary: 2026-10-15，`sogeisetsu` 在两个仓库共完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 10 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交，均位于 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，两次本人提交让 daily-report 流水线的提交归属支持别名与非 GitHub 账号邮箱，并在 agents 文档中补充了别名说明。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，一次 chore 提交将版本标记为 `v1.15.5`。当日无 PR、无 review、无 release。issue 活动共 4 次，全部在 `openchamber/openchamber`：新开 #4920，指出 Context panel 的 breakdown bar 用最后一条消息的 input 去除整段会话估算，导致 `其他` 恒为 0%；关闭 #4346，关于 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 仍能通过；并对 #4346 与 #4111（关于删除 multi-run 后遗留 MCP 子进程、`git worktree remove --force` 报 Permission denied）分别留言。此外，用户参与了一条已有讨论，即 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 #4821「[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel」，该讨论当前共 1 条评论。所有截断标记均为 false，所列活动完整。
